purpose: Template for mutable NPC state entries. Record only established current facts; use npc/NPC_SYSTEM.md, knowledge/KNOWLEDGE_SYSTEM.md and knowledge/META_NON_META_PROTOCOL.md for continuity, knowledge and visibility rules.

npc_entry.profile_source: npc/profiles/<npc_slug>.md or other permanent RHC character source

fact_reference_rule: A fact-reference inherits META/NON-META visibility from knowledge/facts.json. The fact that an NPC knows it does not change its visibility.
combat_state_rules: Permanent combat capability belongs in the profile/battle reference, not live state.
Record only equipment actually worn, carried or deployed now.
A civilian or noncombatant entry may still use equipment genuinely available in the scene.
Follow npc/NPC_SYSTEM.md when permanent combat identity and mutable readiness appear to conflict.
equipment_reference_rules: Use exact item names when known.
Keep resolution-critical mechanics in the battle reference rather than copying them into mutable state.
update_source_rule: Use the source that established the current fact: quicksave, dm_meta, finalized_canon or explicit_user_canon_update.
rules: Use knowledge/KNOWLEDGE_SYSTEM.md for reusable fact IDs and knowledge-locality rules.
Keep biography, personality, voice and long-form history in the permanent profile or dedicated villain file.
Use Unknown or null when a current fact is not established.
Relationships are generic and keyed by the relevant entity; never hardcode one campaign character into the schema.
Knowledge arrays may contain fact-reference objects or concise local knowledge statements when no reusable fact ID is warranted.
Keep NPC knowledge local; do not copy a secret between NPCs or observers without an established reason.
Unclassified local knowledge defaults to META.
Do not treat an uncommitted plan as an NPC fact.
